issues.description: The problem description uses shorter attribute names (inscribedStudents, guestStudents) while the UML and the reference solution use the prefixed names (numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents). This naming discrepancy can confuse students about the exact field names and the corresponding getter/setter names they should implement (tests and UML expect the prefixed names).
issues.suggestedFix: Make attribute names consistent across artifacts. Update the problem statement to refer to numberOfInscribedStudents and numberOfGuestStudents (matching the UML and tests), or modify the UML/tests to accept the shorter names. Additionally, ensure the template hints or comments use the exact expected attribute names so students implement the correct getters/setters.
